subject: Plot error on running saved script

messages.author: 3bd94f65c4684bac
messages.subject: Plot error on running saved script
parts:
Hi Graham,

I have noticed when I load a script I saved from Rattle, it errors in
savePlotToFile(). I believe this is because library(cairoDevice) has
not been called, as when I load it before running the saved R script,
everything is fine. I would have sent a patch but I'm not sure the
appropriate place for the fix.

> plot(crs$rf, main="")
> legend("topright", c("OOB", "0", "1"), text.col=1:6, lty=1:3, col=1:3)
> title(main="Error Rates Random Forest", sub=paste("Rattle", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%b-%d %H:%M:%S"), Sys.info()["user"]))
> savePlotToFile("out.pdf", 1)
Error in dev.copy(Cairo_pdf, file = file.name, width = 10, height = 10) :
object 'Cairo_pdf' not found
>

Platform is Win7 64.

Cheers
Shane

messages.author: 3bd94f65c4684bac
messages.subject: Re: Plot error on running saved script
parts:
Also I noticed windows file paths were not escaped, eg
savePlotToFile("C:\out.pdf", 1), which I think will cause an issue - I
will double check this.
Shane
